ITA-5.66.17 anyatovātaḥ अन्यतोवातः
Referred pain in eye
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: pain in the eyebrows; pain in eyes; severe pain; lack of sliminess; absence of redness; absence of swelling; absence of tears.

ITA-9.9.10 anyadhātūpahitaśukradoṣaḥ अन्यधातूपहितशुक्रदोषः
Semen contaminated with other body elements
A disorder characterised by blood or other tissues mixed with semen.

ITA-5.6.17 anyedyuṣkaviṣamajvaraḥ अन्येद्युष्कविषमज्वरः
Intermittent fever spiking once daily
A disorder characterized by a fever spike once every twenty-four hours.

ITA-1.9.7.5 anyonyābhāvaḥ अन्योन्याभावः
Mutual nonexistence
Nonexistence of a substance in the form of another substance. It refers to the difference of one thing from another thing. e.g. a table is not the chair, denoting the mutual exclusiveness of table and chair and the independent existence of one with respect to the existence or non-existence of the other.
